title: Baghdad Phantom mission report released early (was due for declassification in 2047)

tellings.quote: mission report from the Baghdad Phantom. That was supposed to be declassified in 2047.

plain: A military mission report on the Baghdad Phantom, an incident over Baghdad that the telling does not describe further, was supposed to stay secret until 2047 but has been released early. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, who reports on UFO cases, tells Michels this as a journalist working from his sources, and an early release would mean the report came out decades ahead of schedule.
